summary: Close-up review regions of a car, van, truck or bus.

regions.name: front
regions.summary: nose: bumper, grille, lamps, plate, bonnet edge

regions.name: rear
regions.summary: tail: bumper, lamps, plate, boot or tailgate, exhaust

regions.name: left
regions.summary: left side: profile, doors, sills, arches, mirror

regions.name: right
regions.summary: right side: profile, doors, sills, arches, mirror

regions.name: wheels
regions.summary: each wheel in its arch: liner behind the tyre, clearance, no see-through above the tyre

regions.name: underside
regions.summary: underbody seen from below: floor, axles, exhaust, tank; nothing open into the body

regions.name: interior
regions.summary: cabin with doors and glass hidden: seats, dash, wheel, door cards, floor, headliner

regions.name: engine_bay
regions.summary: engine bay with the bonnet hidden (hero detail): engine block, radiator, battery, bay walls; no see-through into the cabin or onto the road

regions.name: roof
regions.summary: roof and glass seen from above: crown, gutters, rails, pillars
